title: Pepsi® celebrates New York’s reigning champs, The New York Knicks and their fans, with “Champions Deserve Pepsi” ahead of season tip-off
summary: Pepsi teams up with Knicks legend John Starks to introduce limited-edition championship can and ticket sweepstakes that gives Knicks fans a chance to see the team inside The Garden, as new fan billboards hit NYC streets.
body_markdown:
**PURCHASE, NY (October 5, 2026)** - Today, PEPSI® and the New York Knicks are tipping off the 2026–27 season with Champions Deserve Pepsi, a new campaign honoring the team’s historic title and the fans who were there every step of the way.


Starting today, the campaign will hit shelves across New York with limited-edition 16 oz PEPSI® x Knicks Championship cans and limited-edition 20 oz PEPSI® and PEPSI® Zero Sugar x Knicks bottles. Closer to the Knicks’ season tip-off at The Garden, new digital billboards featuring real fan imagery from the playoffs will hit NYC streets.


At the center of Champions Deserve Pepsi is a limited-edition 16 oz PEPSI® x Knicks Championship can, available alongside limited-edition 20 oz PEPSI® and PEPSI® Zero Sugar x Knicks bottles at participating retailers across the Tri-State region. Fans can scan the QR code at point of sale for a chance to win Knicks tickets. In a nod to the 94–90 Game 5 victory that secured the 2026 Championship title, 94 fans will have a chance to visit The Garden, one for every winning point*, through an exclusive sweepstakes program.


“Once a Knick, always a Knick, but the real honor is being part of this fan base for life,” said John Starks, former New York Knicks shooting guard. “New York fans bring an energy you can’t find anywhere else, and they deserve to be at The Garden celebrating this team. I love that Pepsi is putting fans first and giving even more of them a chance to experience it for themselves.”
